notes:
Around 2 weeks ago, i decided to build a LLMs usage tracker. I named it Codenotch. Insane how other devs improve Codenotch using their own creativity and keep adding more features and providers since i decided to open-source this tool so anyone can help to add providers i don't use. Until this time, Codenotch is available for V1.12.0. For those asking where to get Codenotch: http://hivinz.com Recorded with http://screeen.co

Designer: @hivinz_. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
